title: Documentation Generation
summary: This module handles the generation and processing of documentation, including dynamic content like changelogs, code snippet integration, and preparing content for search indexing. It integrates with MkDocs hooks to transform markdown and HTML.

nodes.label: MkDocs Build Process
nodes.title: MkDocs Build Process
nodes.description: The static site generator framework that orchestrates documentation generation by invoking various hooks.

nodes.label: Read Markdown Source
nodes.title: Read Markdown Source
nodes.description: Ingests raw Markdown files from the documentation repository, which may contain special directives for dynamic content.

nodes.label: Apply Markdown Hooks
nodes.title: Apply Markdown Hooks
nodes.description: Executes pre-processing steps on Markdown content before its conversion to HTML, such as injecting code snippets and rendering examples.

nodes.label: Parse Snippet Directives
nodes.title: Parse Snippet Directives
nodes.description: Identifies and extracts parameters (e.g., file path, fragments, highlights) from `snippet` directives embedded in Markdown.

nodes.label: Read Code Snippet Files
nodes.title: Read Code Snippet Files
nodes.description: Accesses local source code files specified by snippet directives to retrieve their content.

nodes.label: Extract Code Sections
nodes.title: Extract Code Sections
nodes.description: Parses code files to identify and extract specific named sections or line ranges based on directive parameters.

nodes.label: Format Code Snippets
nodes.title: Format Code Snippets
nodes.description: Applies syntax highlighting, adds titles, and formats line highlights to extracted code for embedding into Markdown.

nodes.label: Generate HTML Output
nodes.title: Generate HTML Output
nodes.description: Converts the processed Markdown content into final HTML pages, forming the core of the documentation site.

nodes.label: Prepare HTML for Search
nodes.title: Prepare HTML for Search
nodes.description: Cleans and structures generated HTML content, removing UI elements and extracting relevant text for Algolia search indexing.

nodes.label: Write Algolia Index File
nodes.title: Write Algolia Index File
nodes.description: Serializes and saves the collected Algolia search records into a JSON file, ready for upload to the Algolia service.

nodes.label: Fetch GitHub Releases
nodes.title: Fetch GitHub Releases
nodes.description: Retrieves release and changelog data from the GitHub API to dynamically generate release notes within the documentation.

nodes.label: Cache Changelog Data
nodes.title: Cache Changelog Data
nodes.description: Stores and retrieves processed changelog data using a Key-Value store to reduce API calls and improve load times.

nodes.label: Format Changelog Entries
nodes.title: Format Changelog Entries
nodes.description: Transforms raw GitHub release data into a human-readable and Markdown-compatible changelog format for display.

nodes.label: Serve Raw Text Assets
nodes.title: Serve Raw Text Assets
nodes.description: Handles requests for documentation assets, serving them as plain text if the client prefers or requests it.

nodes.label: GitHub API
nodes.title: GitHub API
nodes.description: External service providing release and repository information for changelog generation.

nodes.label: Algolia Search Service
nodes.title: Algolia Search Service
nodes.description: External search service that consumes the generated index file to provide search functionality for the documentation.

nodes.label: Key-Value Store
nodes.title: Key-Value Store
nodes.description: External persistent storage used for caching dynamic content like changelog data.

nodes.label: Local File System
nodes.title: Local File System
nodes.description: Provides access to local files for reading code snippets and writing generated outputs like Algolia records.

nodes.label: Web Asset Storage
nodes.title: Web Asset Storage
nodes.description: Storage for documentation assets (e.g., images, raw text files) that can be served directly by the web server.

groups.label: Content Transformation
groups.title: Content Transformation Pipeline
groups.description: Manages the flow from raw Markdown to final HTML, applying various processing steps and hooks.

groups.label: Code Snippet Management
groups.title: Code Snippet Integration
groups.description: Handles the parsing, extraction, and formatting of code snippets from source files for embedding into documentation.

groups.label: Search Indexing
groups.title: Algolia Search Indexing
groups.description: Processes generated HTML content to create structured records for Algolia, enabling efficient search functionality.

groups.label: Changelog Generation
groups.title: Dynamic Changelog Generation
groups.description: Fetches release information from GitHub, caches it, and formats it into a changelog for inclusion in the documentation.

groups.label: Asset Delivery
groups.title: Raw Text Asset Delivery
groups.description: Manages the serving of raw text assets directly from storage, bypassing standard HTML rendering.
